# speaking

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:profModalitySpeaking`](gmeow-profModalitySpeaking.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/profModalitySpeaking>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/languages`](../../slices/languages.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The speaking proficiency modality — a specific skill channel (receptive, productive, signing, etc.) on which proficiency is assessed.

## Structure

**Types:** [`gmeow:ProficiencyModality`](../classes/gmeow-ProficiencyModality.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:profModalitySpeaking`](gmeow-profModalitySpeaking.md) as a controlled value typed as [`gmeow:ProficiencyModality`](../classes/gmeow-ProficiencyModality.md).
